reviews.text: I have been taking my schnoodle here (specifically to Tommy) for the past 2 years and they are amazing! They always listen to my requests and send me pictures/ updates during the appointment. She always comes back smelling great and looking so fabulous! I know my doggie is in good hands when I drop her off! Bailey and I love it here!

Today my fur daughter turned 12 and had the best grooming/spa experience ever. Thank you for taking care of my old girl on her special day! This photo was created for me to celebrate Nora by the awesome groomer!
Excelent job! I love the way they took care my puppy!

I’ve been taking my dogs to Marie’s pet grooming for years now and always had a positive experience. They communicate well and pay attention to whatever request I make. Over the years they have groomed my very senior dog and now a pup. My dogs comes home looking better and I feel safe leaving my pups with them.

We’ve been bringing our Toy Poodle here for years, and I can honestly say this place is amazing. It’s one of the very few groomers that truly understands what a traditional Poodle cut should look like…not a Doodle or Shih Tzu trim.

Before finding this salon, we tried nearly every groomer within a 10-mile radius. No matter where we went, we could never get the look we wanted unless we practically picked up the clippers ourselves! The groomers here consistently do an excellent job and always get it right.

Even though our dog is old and a little grumpy, she loves the staff and that says a lot. They’re professional, patient, kind, and their prices are very reasonable.

I recommend this place a million times over. If you’re looking for groomers who actually know how to groom a Poodle properly, this is the place to go!

I just took my senior Yorkie Roo here for the first time and this is definitely going to be our go-to groomer from now on. We had to switch groomers because our last groomer wasn’t the most reliable but I don’t think that’ll be a problem at Marie’s!  The service and cut were great and you can tell the workers really care about your dog.

They also have a mirror so you can see your dog and I really appreciate the transparency. I went to pick her up after her appointment and she’s never been so calm after a grooming appt. Will definitely be back for her next grooming!
We absolutely love this place and our dog loves it too. She’s always happy to go in and comes out fabulous every time! 10/10 VIP service.
I am very satisfied. Thank you so much for cutting Rufus' hair so cleanly and beautifully, and for being so kind and loving to our dog. Thank you so much Tammy

Wonderful service, great attention, nice people doing great job. Thank you. They have very great prices. We new in the area and we definitely as long we live here we going to continue getting the service here. 5 star ⭐️. Recommend %100 . Thank you.

Finding a good groomer is stressful but getting her groomers here was amazing. I messaged them about an appointment and everything went smooth, good communication and I got pictures of the final result. The fur baby was given the cut that I asked for. Thank you so much! We couldn’t see her beautiful face now we can 💖
